O.outcome_detail: alignment of median pupils' IQs with the normal range

result.effect: median IQs ranged from 0.93 to 1.04 across the lowest- and highest-scoring groups in the twelfth year

cells.quote: This criterion is very admirably fulfilled. In the twelfth year, where the discrepancies are the greatest, the median child in the lowest scoring group has an IQ of 0.93, and the median child in the highest scoring group has 1.04 for an IQ. The other deviations from 1.00 are much smaller.
cells.note: The study presents the separate-community method as preferable to lumping results, but does not report a formal statistical comparison.

D.treatment: actual median ages by community and month

cells.quote: It has heretofore been the assumption that the children of a certain age have a median exactly at the half year, that is, for example, the children from 13.0 to 13.99 years old have a median of 13.5 years. This supposition was found to be incorrect in relation to the pupils studied for these standards. In one community the median 11 year old was only 11.33, and there were many smaller variations.
cells.note: The text reports that the customary half-year age assumption was incorrect, motivating month-level age distributions.
